Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint

Class CockroachDBSaver

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint.AbstractCheckpointSaver
org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint.CockroachDBSaver
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseCheckpointSaver
public class CockroachDBSaver extends AbstractCheckpointSaver
Checkpoint saver backed by CockroachDB.

CockroachDB speaks the PostgreSQL wire protocol, so this saver uses the standard org.postgresql.Driver and the same DDL that PostgresSaver uses (two tables: LG4JThread and LG4JCheckpoint, state serialized to bytes and base64-wrapped in a JSONB column). Cross-database migration to or from a PostgreSQL-backed checkpoint store is therefore straightforward.

Every SQL construct in this class is supported on CockroachDB v22.1 and later: JSONB, UUID, partial unique indexes with WHERE, ON CONFLICT ... WHERE ... DO NOTHING, and ON DELETE CASCADE.

Build with the CockroachDBSaver.Builder returned by builder(): 


 CockroachDBSaver saver = CockroachDBSaver.builder()
         .host("localhost")
         .port(26257)
         .database("defaultdb")
         .user("root")
         .password("")
         .stateSerializer(new ObjectStreamStateSerializer<>(AgentState::new))
         .createTables(true)
         .build();
